name: scrum-assistant
description: Agente inteligente para la guía y validación del proceso Scrum (prototipo académico)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
